delta.note: Non-final periods now use TER: rate from the Lampiran bracket table (category via PTKP status) times gross_income (existing fact, assumed to already include employer JKK/JKM/health premiums); the annualisation rules for non-final periods are closed at 2019-12-31 per Pasal 5, while the existing final-period reconciliation rules already match Pasal 4. Rounding of the monthly amount is not specified, so the existing pph_round_mode parameter is used.

output.reason: The regulation introduces monthly effective rates (Tarif Efektif Bulanan) for withholding PPh 21 on permanent employees in every tax period except the last. It groups the rates into two PTKP categories with rate tables in the Lampiran and defines the gross income they apply to, including employer-paid JKK, JKM and health premiums. It also sets the final-period annual reconciliation and repeals the annualization method for non-final periods. These change the calculation steps, rates and brackets for pegawai tetap. Effective from 1 January 2020.
